title: Candy
overview: Crescent and Corona draw portraits of Funny, but she throws away Crescent's, while rewarding Corona with a candy stick. Crescent becomes jealous of the affection Funny is giving Corona, so he attempts to steal the candy stick from him.

title: Hunting
overview: Crescent and Corona are hungry but Funny is too tired to feed them so they go out to hunt some food for themselves. Unfortunately, their attempts to catch the clever owl rats end up taking a turn for the worse.

title: Cabbage
overview: Crescent draws a face on a cabbage, much to Funny's delight. However, Corona becomes fed up with them treating the cabbage better than him, so he tries to get rid of it.

title: Black Hole
overview: Funny and Crescent discover that Corona has a black hole inside his mouth.

title: Ghost
overview: Crescent chokes to death on an apple and comes back as a ghost.

title: Picture Book
overview: Crescent discovers a live whale inside Funny's picture book.

title: Rainbow
overview: Funny and the aliens drive to see a rainbow up close, but they soon find out that it is no ordinary rainbow.

title: Flight
overview: Funny and the aliens become trapped on an air balloon as it descends to the ground, leaving them to face certain death unless they escape.

title: Birthday
overview: Crescent becomes depressed when no one will eat the birthday cake he made for Funny.

title: Three Matches
overview: Crescent crashes his car, leaving he, Funny, Corona, and the owl rats stranded in the middle of the cold desert, with nothing but three matches to keep them warm.

title: Photograph
overview: Crescent is upset that he can never seem to make it into a picture, so he puts Corona in danger for the sake of Funny taking the perfect photo.

title: Circle
overview: Crescent decides that shaping his head into a circle like Corona's is the best way to win Funny's affection.

title: Love
overview: Funny becomes obsessed with a picture of a handsome man, leaving Crescent and Corona without any food.

title: Repayment of a Favor
overview: Crescent frees Horley from a bear trap, and his family comes to thank Crescent for his act of kindness. Unfortunately, their method of rewarding Crescent is much different than he expected.

title: Replay
overview: Corona becomes depressed after his frog friend gets run over by a circus truck. Crescent feels bad for him, and tries to bring the frog back to life.

title: Gift
overview: Corona can fart clouds.

title: Evil and Just
overview: After she drinks an orange potion, the two halves of Funny's personality are unleashed. One good, and one evil. But Crescent quickly learns not to judge a book by its cover.

title: Hidden
overview: Crescent accidentally wets the bed, and tries to hide the evidence by any means necessary.

title: Treatment
overview: A mysterious masked figure stalks and harms various characters.

title: Goldfish
overview: Crescent and Corona experience the most nightmare-inducing time of their lives.

title: Forbidden Game
overview: Funny manipulates Crescent into playing a dangerous game, that involves killing others.

title: Loneliness
overview: Crescent wakes up to find that Funny and Corona are gone, leaving him completely alone. In his depressed state, he cuts an imaginary version of himself out of his shadow.

title: Chocolate
overview: Crescent, Corona, and the owl rats steal a chocolate bar from Funny, but fight over who gets the last piece.

title: Going Home
overview: Crescent and Corona finally find a way to fix their ship and go back home, leaving Funny in despair.
